name: AddonNest for Elementor
author: TheBitCraft

sections.description:
AddonNest for Elementor is a free Elementor addon that empowers your website-building experience with 20+ advanced widgets for WooCommerce stores, restaurants, portfolios, agencies, and blogs. Build professional and dynamic websites faster with drag-and-drop simplicity — no coding required.

Whether you’re creating an eCommerce store, showcasing your creative portfolio, or launching a restaurant website, AddonNest gives you the tools to build visually stunning layouts with ease.

🚀 Why AddonNest Stands Out:

✔ 20+ Premium-Grade Widgets – Sliders, galleries, pricing tables & dynamic content
✔ WooCommerce Optimized – Boost product pages & conversions
✔ Lightning Fast – Clean code for better SEO & performance
✔ 100% Mobile Responsive – Flawless on all devices
✔ Drag & Drop Simplicity – No technical skills required
✔ Regular Free Updates – New widgets added monthly

🏆 Perfect For:

  • eCommerce stores using WooCommerce
  • Restaurants & food businesses
  • Creative portfolios & agencies
  • Corporate websites & blogs

📌 Works seamlessly with: Elementor Pro, WooCommerce, and all major WordPress themes.

🚀 Key Features

🔥 20+ Premium-Quality Widgets: Expand your design possibilities with a diverse collection of high-quality widgets, from sliders and countdowns to dynamic galleries and pricing tables.
🔥 Enhance Your Website Design with Ease: Create visually stunning layouts without any hassle—perfect for businesses, portfolios, eCommerce, and more.
🔥 Fully Customizable & Responsive: Every widget is fully adjustable to match your brand, with mobile-friendly designs that look great on all devices.
🔥 Fast, Lightweight & Optimized for Performance: Built with clean code to ensure fast loading times and smooth performance without slowing down your site.
🔥 Seamless Integration with Elementor: Works flawlessly with both Elementor Free & Pro, giving you more flexibility in your page-building process.
🔥 No Coding Required – Drag & Drop Simplicity: Intuitive controls let you design like a pro—just drag, drop, and customize in real-time.
🔥 Elevate Your Elementor Experience with AddonNest: Take your website to the next level with professional-grade widgets that save time and boost engagement.
🔥 Dynamic Content Widgets: Display blogs, events, and news with beautiful layouts
🔥 WooCommerce Boosters: ** Product grids, shop banners, and pricing tables
🔥 **Interactive Elements: Countdown timers, sliders, and timelines
🔥 Design Essentials: Hero videos, media cards, and photo galleries
🔥 Regular Updates – Continuous improvements and new widget additions.

🛠️ 20+ Powerful Widgets Included:

We’ve crafted over 20 powerful widgets to elevate your Elementor page-building experience and help you unlock your full design potential.

📦 AddonNest Widget Categories

📰 Dynamic Content & Blogging

  1. Blog List – Display posts in grid/list layouts.
  2. Breaking News – Highlight urgent updates.
  3. Events List – Showcase upcoming events.

🛒 WooCommerce & eCommerce

  1. Product Categories Grid – Organize shop categories.
  2. Shop Banner – Promotional banners for stores.
  3. Pricing Table – Compare product plans.

🍽️ Restaurant & Food Business

  1. Restaurant Menu – Beautiful dish listings.
  2. Special Menu – Highlight chef’s recommendations.
  3. Restaurant Schedule – Opening hours/widget.

⚡ Interactive Elements

  1. Countdown – Timers for sales/events.
  2. AddonNest Slider – Responsive image sliders.
  3. AddonNest TimeLine – Visual history/roadmap.

📊 Layout & Design

  1. Hero Video – Fullscreen video headers.
  2. Media Card – Image + text combos.
  3. Photo Gallery – Grid/masonry layouts.

🛠️ Functional Widgets

  1. Call Contact Form – Lead generation forms.
  2. Features Addon – Icon + text features.
  3. Navigating Features – Step-by-step guides.

🎯 Branding & Misc.

  1. AddonNest Title – Stylish headings.
  2. Animated Headline – Dynamic text effects.
  3. Team Members – Staff profiles.
  4. Services – Service showcase.
  5. Online Delivery Banner – Promo for delivery services.
sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements

  • PHP version 5.6.0 or greater (PHP 7.4 or greater is recommended)
  • MySQL version 5.0 or greater (MySQL 5.6 or greater is recommended)

Automatic installation

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in WordPress
  2. Search for “AddonNest”
  3. Click Install Now and activate

OR manually upload the ZIP file via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
sections.faq:
Q. Is this compatible with Elementor Pro?

A. Yes! Works perfectly with both Elementor Free and Pro.

Q. How often are new widgets added?

A. We release new widgets every month – stay tuned!

Q. Where can I get support?

A. Email us at hello@thebitcraft.com or visit our support forum.

Q. Can I use my existing WordPress theme?

A. Sure, you can use your existing WordPress theme with AddonNest.

Q. Where can I report a bug?

A. Found a bug? Please let us know by posting on the support section of this plugin on the WordPress plugin directory or directly via email at: hello@thebitcraft.com
